versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02083 Regarding signal groups with ComTransferProperty TRIGGERED_ON_CHANGE which do not contain any signals that have an own ComTransferProperty config- ured: At any send request of such a signal group assigned to an I-PDU with ComTxMode- Mode DIRECT or MIXED , the AUTOSAR COM module shall immediately (within the next main function at the latest) initiate ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions plus one transmissions of the assigned I-PDU, if at least one new sent group signal differs to the locally stored (last sent or init) in length or value.
